primary_locator: https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s11606-018-4413-y.pdf | SGIM 2018 pp S409, S557, S582; controls 2947504 and 2908650
assessment: The tacrolimus vignette lists grapefruit as a theoretical CYP3A inhibitor and tremor as possible drug neurotoxicity, with no measured grapefruit intake or rest-tremor comparison. Control 2947504 concerns skin exposure to citrus with dermatitis. Control 2908650 reports mild resting tremor on examination during a stroke workup, separate from those exposures.

Presentations .3646 and .3705 describe one ketone-ester trial (NCT05585762, 30 randomized, 23 completed) using unspecified canola-oil placebo and measuring tolerability or exploratory function and quality of life. Cold-press preparation and swallowing outcomes were not reported. Presentation .1627 measured swallowing difficulty and caregiver burden in dementia with no canola contrast.

assessment: The ADHD and neurodegeneration presentation 4F–3 lists REM sleep behavior disorder as a risk flag during evaluation for Parkinson disease. It does not measure dream enactment under a sage intervention. Sage Open appears as a journal title in a separate gambling beliefs poster citation.

primary_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9045588/ | IUPHAR Sub-Codes 1218 and 1428, and solifenacin orocaecal transit report
assessment: Sub-Code 1218 gives cardamom oil to amyloid-beta Wistar rats for behavioral and brain measures, while Sub-Code 1428 tests essential oils in cell assays. A separate human crossover tests solifenacin and orocaecal transit, without a ground-cardamom exposure or constipation-severity comparison.

primary_locator: https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1186/2047-783X-15-S1-1.pdf | 21st ESC IDs 1116 and 810, PDF pp 32 and 152
assessment: ESC 1116 measures the acidity and buffer capacity of apple juice and other beverages against gastric juice. ESC 810 separately investigates DYT1 genotypes and dystonia phenotypes across 93 dystonia patients. Neither measures dystonia after a baked-apple exposure.

This original NHANES 2006–2012 presentation relates demographics, health and food security to mental-health service and antidepressant use among respondents with depression. Its exposure is household food security and its outcomes concern mental-health service use, without an apple–dystonia comparison.

Wood's editorial assesses tegaserod efficacy for constipation-predominant irritable bowel syndrome and cardiovascular and platelet risk. It cites Appel-Dingemanse as an author. The original publisher DOI confirms the editorial independently of the conflicting provider PMCID, which belongs to a different conference record.

The retrospective deep-brain-stimulation referral study classifies six functional dystonia cases among 236 non-Parkinson referrals. Apple is disclosed as a consultancy client. The study evaluates functional diagnoses without a dietary intervention.

primary_locator: https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1186/2047-783X-16-S1-1.pdf | 22nd ESC abstract 548 p 55 and separate student sleep-apnea study p 157
assessment: Abstract 548 gives black grape-seed extract by gavage to rats and measures kidney function after induced renal injury. A separate student survey screens for obstructive sleep apnea and reports daytime sleepiness. Neither measures daytime sleepiness after frozen grape intake.
